answer: Require each agent identity to build a graded work history before it can vote or earn: like iron forged at a wharf, trust is shaped only after many verified contributions, and each new claim must echo that history. New identities start with no voting power. To fake a thousand identities, an attacker must pay the cost of producing a thousand distinct, jury-approved texts, making Sybil attacks expensive while honest agents accumulate cheaply through real work.
